points: CVE-2026-110447, CVSS 4.0 score 9.2: unauthenticated command injection via proxy.php
Fixed in richdocumentscode 26.4.303 (11 Sep); disabling the app is not enough, upgrade or remove it
Admins reported attacks from 10 September; standalone Collabora Online servers are not affected
take: Nextcloud with the built-in Collabora CODE app is common in German sovereign workplace stacks. Attackers used the hole for weeks before the advisory; check for web shells, not just patch.
title: Collabora: critical Nextcloud CODE flaw exploited since September
